Our mission is clear: to deliver secure, ROI-driven innovation that helps businesses from Suresnes to Sydney scale, adapt, and thrive.
about.meaning.title: What Does Algorythmos Mean?
about.meaning.algorithm.title: Algorithm
about.meaning.rhythmos.title: Rhythmos
about.meaning.p1: Algorythmos is born from two worlds. <blue>"Algorithm"</blue>, the domain of logic and structured intelligence. And <purple>"Rhythmos"</purple>, the Greek idea of flow, harmony, and natural pattern. Together, they form a brand built on balance: rigorous reasoning paired with the rhythm of real business life.
about.meaning.p2: For us, the algorithm represents precision, automation, and the intelligence behind every decision. The rhythm represents timing, human context, and the way every organisation moves at its own pace.
about.meaning.p3: Algorythmos stands for AI that doesn't fight your workflow but moves with it – learning your patterns, adapting to your tempo, and becoming a natural part of how your team operates every day.
about.mission.title: Our Mission
about.mission.content: Algorythmos helps enterprises unlock the real value of their data with secure, practical, ROI‑driven AI. We design, build, and integrate solutions that reduce costs, save time, and improve decision‑making.
about.vision.title: Our Vision
about.vision.content: A world where AI is trustworthy by design—compliant with GDPR and the EU AI Act, engineered with AppSec and LLMSecOps, and built to augment people, not replace them.
about.impact.title: Our Impact
about.impact.content: From rapid prototypes to production systems, we deliver measurable outcomes: faster cycles, fewer manual steps, and clearer decisions. We partner end‑to‑end—from strategy to MLOps with CI/CD.

serviceAgentic.hero.subtitle: Algorythmos delivers agentic automation solutions for SMEs and enterprises in France and Australia. Orchestrate multi-step workflows across your CRM, ERP, email, and data warehouse with AI agents that understand context, follow policies, and act with full auditability—from Sydney to Suresnes.

serviceAgentic.whatItIs.title: What It Is
serviceAgentic.whatItIs.p1: Agentic AI goes beyond chatbots. It coordinates multiple steps to complete real business workflows—not just answer questions. Think of it as your digital workforce that can draft emails, update CRM records, trigger approvals, query databases, and escalate edge cases to humans.
serviceAgentic.whatItIs.p2: Unlike brittle RPA scripts, agents adapt to context, handle exceptions gracefully, and integrate with CRMs, ERPs, data warehouses, and internal APIs—all with full traceability and policy controls.
serviceAgentic.howItWorks.title: How It Works
serviceAgentic.howItWorks.0.title: Deterministic Tools + Policy Prompts
serviceAgentic.howItWorks.0.description: We connect agents to your systems through explicit, validated tools (functions). Each action goes through input/output validation and policy-enforced prompts that encode business rules and compliance requirements.
serviceAgentic.howItWorks.1.title: Human-in-the-Loop Review Queues
serviceAgentic.howItWorks.1.description: Sensitive actions (like sending money, deleting records, or approving contracts) can be routed to human reviewers before execution. This gives you confidence while maintaining speed for routine tasks.
serviceAgentic.howItWorks.2.title: Monitoring, Cost Controls & Governance
serviceAgentic.howItWorks.2.description: Full observability with metrics, traces, and logs. Set cost budgets per workflow, track token usage, and maintain audit-ready lineage for every decision and action taken by the agents.
serviceAgentic.businessImpact.title: Business Impact
serviceAgentic.businessImpact.0.title: 30–60% reduction in repetitive work
serviceAgentic.businessImpact.0.descript: Free up your team to focus on high-value tasks while agents handle routine operations.
serviceAgentic.businessImpact.1.title: Faster cycle times, fewer handoffs
serviceAgentic.businessImpact.1.descript: Workflows that used to take days now complete in minutes with automated coordination.
serviceAgentic.businessImpact.2.title: Actionable audit trails
serviceAgentic.businessImpact.2.descript: Every action is logged with full context—perfect for compliance, debugging, and optimization.
serviceAgentic.businessImpact.3.title: Spend visibility & cost control
serviceAgentic.businessImpact.3.descript: Track LLM token usage, API calls, and compute costs per workflow with real-time budgets.
serviceAgentic.architecture.title: Reference Architecture
serviceAgentic.architecture.p1: We integrate with orchestrators like LangGraph, CrewAI, or custom state machines. Memory layer powered by Weaviate, pgvector, or OpenSearch. Full CI/CD for prompts, tools, and evaluation datasets.
serviceAgentic.architecture.p2: Deploy on your infrastructure (on-prem, VPC, or cloud) with SSO, RBAC, and private networking.
serviceAgentic.faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
serviceAgentic.faqs.0.question: How is this safer than a regular LLM bot?
serviceAgentic.faqs.0.answer: Actions go through explicit tools with input/output validation, policy prompts, and optional human review before execution. You control what the agent can and cannot do.
serviceAgentic.faqs.1.question: Do you support on-premises deployment?
serviceAgentic.faqs.1.answer: Yes. We can deploy the full stack on your infrastructure with SSO, RBAC, and private networking. Perfect for regulated industries or sensitive data.
serviceAgentic.faqs.2.question: What systems can you integrate with?
serviceAgentic.faqs.2.answer: Most CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot), ERPs (SAP, NetSuite), email (Gmail, Outlook), Slack, databases, and custom APIs. We build connectors as needed.
serviceAgentic.faqs.3.question: How do you handle errors and edge cases?
serviceAgentic.faqs.3.answer: Agents can retry with backoff, escalate to human review queues, or fail gracefully with detailed error logs. We design workflows for resilience.

serviceDocument.whatItIs.title: What It Is
serviceDocument.whatItIs.p1: Document Intelligence transforms unstructured PDFs, scanned images, and digital documents into clean, structured data ready for your finance, procurement, and operations workflows.
serviceDocument.whatItIs.p2: Whether it's invoices from dozens of vendors, purchase orders with complex line items, contracts with nested clauses, or KYC/compliance documents—we extract the data accurately and route it to your ERP, database, or data warehouse with full audit trails.
serviceDocument.howItWorks.title: How It Works
serviceDocument.howItWorks.ocr.title: Enterprise OCR + Layout Analysis
serviceDocument.howItWorks.ocr.descripti: We use state-of-the-art OCR engines (Tesseract, AWS Textract, Azure Document Intelligence) combined with layout parsing to understand table structures, multi-column layouts, and handwritten annotations.
serviceDocument.howItWorks.extraction.de: Custom extraction rules and ML models trained on your document types. Schema validation ensures data integrity—fields with low confidence are flagged for human review before export.
serviceDocument.howItWorks.gdpr.title: GDPR Compliance + Security
serviceDocument.howItWorks.gdpr.descript: All processing happens in GDPR-compliant regions with encryption at rest and in transit. Role-based access control (RBAC), audit logs, and data retention policies ensure regulatory compliance.
serviceDocument.useCases.title: Common Use Cases
serviceDocument.useCases.0.title: Invoice & Logistics Automation
serviceDocument.useCases.0.description: Extract vendor details, line items, totals, and tax from invoices. Auto-match with purchase orders and route to ERP for approval.
serviceDocument.useCases.1.title: KYC & Compliance Documents
serviceDocument.useCases.1.description: Extract identity data, registration numbers, and signatures from passports, IDs, and incorporation documents for onboarding workflows.
serviceDocument.useCases.2.title: Contract Review & Clause Extraction
serviceDocument.useCases.2.description: Identify key terms, obligations, renewal dates, and risk clauses from contracts and NDAs. Build a searchable contract database.
serviceDocument.useCases.3.title: Multi-Vendor Template Handling
serviceDocument.useCases.3.description: Adapt quickly to new vendor formats with few-shot learning and pattern rules. No need to retrain models from scratch.
serviceDocument.businessImpact.title: Business Impact
serviceDocument.businessImpact.0.title: 50% less manual keying
serviceDocument.businessImpact.0.descrip: Free your finance and ops teams from tedious data entry. Focus on exceptions and value-add tasks.
serviceDocument.businessImpact.1.title: Higher accuracy and faster approvals
serviceDocument.businessImpact.1.descrip: Validated extractions mean fewer errors and faster processing cycles—critical for month-end close.
serviceDocument.businessImpact.2.title: Standardized data across vendors
serviceDocument.businessImpact.2.descrip: Normalize data from hundreds of vendor formats into a single schema for consistent reporting.
serviceDocument.businessImpact.3.title: Audit-ready compliance
serviceDocument.businessImpact.3.descrip: Full lineage from document to extraction to export. Perfect for SOX, GDPR, and ISO audits.
serviceDocument.faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
serviceDocument.faqs.0.question: Which file types are supported?
serviceDocument.faqs.0.answer: PDF, PNG, JPG, TIFF, and most common image formats. We support batch ingestion via S3/GCS, REST API, or web UI upload.
serviceDocument.faqs.1.question: Can it learn new document templates?
serviceDocument.faqs.1.answer: Yes. Our models adapt quickly to new vendor formats using few-shot tuning and pattern rules—no need for extensive retraining.
serviceDocument.faqs.2.question: How do you handle low-quality scans?
serviceDocument.faqs.2.answer: We apply image preprocessing (deskewing, noise reduction, contrast enhancement) before OCR. Fields with low confidence are flagged for human review.
serviceDocument.faqs.3.question: Is it GDPR-compliant?
serviceDocument.faqs.3.answer: Absolutely. All processing happens in EU/GDPR-compliant regions with encryption, RBAC, audit logs, and configurable data retention policies.
serviceDocument.faqs.4.question: How do you integrate with our ERP?
serviceDocument.faqs.4.answer: We provide REST APIs, webhooks, and pre-built connectors for SAP, NetSuite, Dynamics, and custom systems. Data can also be exported to your data warehouse.

serviceSqlDashboards.whatItIs.p1: SQL-based dashboards give SME leaders a unified view of their business: operations KPIs, finance metrics, customer health, support SLAs, and more—all powered by a single, modeled data layer.

serviceSqlDashboards.howItWorks.alerts.d: Set thresholds and anomaly detection rules. Get notified in Slack or email when KPIs deviate—catch issues before they become crises.

serviceMlops.whatItIs.title: What It Is
serviceMlops.whatItIs.p1: MLOps (Machine Learning Operations) is the practice of deploying, monitoring, and maintaining ML models in production with the same rigor as traditional software engineering. Think DevOps, but for AI.
serviceMlops.whatItIs.p2: We build opinionated paths to production covering testing, evaluation, deployment patterns, observability, and governance—ensuring your models survive the real world and deliver consistent value.
serviceMlops.howItWorks.title: How It Works
serviceMlops.howItWorks.cicd.title: CI/CD Pipelines with Quality Gates
serviceMlops.howItWorks.cicd.description: Automated testing, evaluation, bias checks, and performance SLOs at every commit. Models are versioned, packaged, and deployed only when they meet quality thresholds.
serviceMlops.howItWorks.observability.de: Track prediction latency, error rates, feature distributions, and model drift in production. Get alerted before performance degrades and retrain proactively.
serviceMlops.howItWorks.governance.title: Governance & Security
serviceMlops.howItWorks.governance.descr: RBAC, SSO, audit logs, and data lineage for compliance. Deploy on your infrastructure (on-prem, VPC, or cloud) with private networking and secrets management.

serviceMlops.architecture.pipeline: Git Repo → CI/CD (GitHub Actions / GitLab CI) → Model Registry (MLflow / Weights & Biases) → Container Registry (Docker / ECR) → Kubernetes / Serverless → Monitoring (Prometheus / Grafana / Datadog)
serviceMlops.architecture.training: Experiments tracked in MLflow/W&B. Models versioned and validated before promotion.
serviceMlops.architecture.deployment: Containerized with Docker, deployed to Kubernetes (on-prem or cloud) or serverless (Lambda, Cloud Run).
serviceMlops.architecture.monitoring: Latency, error rates, feature drift, and model performance tracked in real-time with alerts.
serviceMlops.architecture.governance: RBAC, audit logs, data lineage, and compliance checks baked into every step.

blogDetail.posts.gdpr-ai.title: GDPR & AI: What SMEs Need to Know
blogDetail.posts.gdpr-ai.meta: How to ensure AI systems are GDPR-ready and aligned with the EU AI Act.
blogDetail.posts.gdpr-ai.content.0.parag: SMEs adopting AI must align with GDPR and prepare for the EU AI Act. The goal is simple: protect personal data, design for transparency, and document risk mitigations.
This guide outlines practical steps for data mapping, DPIA preparation, and model governance so your AI projects are compliant by design.
Data minimization and lawful basis for processing
Human oversight for high-risk AI systems
Model and data lineage with audit trails
blogDetail.posts.gdpr-ai.content.2.parag: Start with a data inventory, map flows, and identify risks. Establish governance with clear owners, versioning, and review cadences.
Adopt secure MLOps practices with automated testing, bias checks, and drift detection to ensure continuous compliance.
blogDetail.posts.mlops-production.title: MLOps: From Prototype to Production
blogDetail.posts.mlops-production.meta: Best practices for scaling AI securely using CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes.
blogDetail.posts.mlops-production.conten: Moving from notebooks to production requires repeatable pipelines, strong observability, and clear ownership. MLOps brings DevOps discipline to AI.
CI/CD for models reduces release friction and increases reliability. This lets teams ship improvements fast without sacrificing safety.
Model registry with versioning and lineage
Blue/green or canary rollouts with rollback
Combine Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD to standardize packaging and deployments. Add feature stores, experiment tracking, and policy-as-code for guardrails.

blogDetail.posts.agentic-ai.meta: Multi-step, goal-driven automation for real business outcomes.
blogDetail.posts.agentic-ai.content.0.pa: Agentic AI orchestrates tools and APIs to complete tasks end-to-end. It moves beyond question answering to deliver measurable outcomes.
blogDetail.posts.llmsecops.title: LLMSecOps: Securing Large Language Models
blogDetail.posts.llmsecops.meta: A lifecycle approach to safe, trustworthy AI adoption.
blogDetail.posts.llmsecops.content.0.par: LLMs introduce new risks: prompt injection, data leakage, and jailbreaks. LLMSecOps applies security controls across the model lifecycle.

blogDetail.posts.ai-websites-advantage.c: Traditional websites are static brochures. AI-powered websites are intelligent assistants that engage visitors 24/7, qualify leads automatically, and provide instant answers to complex questions.

blogDetail.posts.voice-ai-automation.met: Practical guide to deploying voice interfaces for 24/7 customer support.
blogDetail.posts.voice-ai-automation.con: Voice AI has matured beyond simple IVR menus. Modern systems understand natural language, handle complex queries, and seamlessly escalate to humans when needed.

Design conversational flows with clear escalation paths

blogDetail.posts.chatbots-agents-rag.met: When to use chatbots, autonomous agents, or RAG for your business.
blogDetail.posts.chatbots-agents-rag.con: Not all AI solutions are created equal. Simple chatbots handle FAQs, agents orchestrate multi-step workflows, and RAG systems answer questions from your proprietary documents.
Chatbots: High-volume FAQs, appointment booking, basic support
Agents: Complex workflows, CRM updates, multi-system coordination

Often the best solution combines multiple approaches

pricing.new.faq.0.question: How does onboarding work?
pricing.new.faq.0.answer: We start with a discovery call to understand your workflows, then design a pilot scope together. Our engineers deploy within 2–4 weeks, with iterative refinement based on your feedback. You get full documentation and training before handoff.
pricing.new.faq.1.question: Do you mark up cloud or LLM costs?
pricing.new.faq.1.answer: No. All infrastructure and API costs are passed through at cost. Our pricing covers engineering, support, and platform access only. You maintain full visibility into your cloud spend.
pricing.new.faq.2.question: How do you measure accuracy?
pricing.new.faq.2.answer: We use exact-match and semantic similarity metrics, plus human review sampling. Every deployment includes an accuracy dashboard so you can track performance against your KPIs in real-time.
pricing.new.faq.3.question: Can you deploy in our cloud?
pricing.new.faq.3.answer: Yes. We support private VPC deployments on AWS, GCP, or Azure. For highly regulated industries, we also offer fully on-premise setups with air-gapped security.
pricing.new.faq.4.question: What counts as an 'item'?
pricing.new.faq.4.answer: An item is one unit processed through the system — for example, one document, one email, one API call, or one chat message. Complex documents with multiple pages still count as one item.
